title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
description: Application experienced database connection pool exhaustion leading to service degradation

timeline.event: Alert triggered: High database connection usage
Hotfix deployed to fix connection leak

contributing_factors.description: Recent code changes introduced a database connection leak that was not caught in testing
Alert thresholds were set too high, delaying detection of the issue

action_items.title: Fix database connection leak
action_items.description: Identify and fix the root cause of the connection leak in the codebase

action_items.title: Review and adjust monitoring thresholds
action_items.description: Review all database monitoring thresholds and adjust to catch issues earlier

action_items.title: Implement connection pool monitoring
action_items.description: Add detailed monitoring for connection pool usage and implement automated alerts

what_went_wrong: Connection leak was not caught in pre-deployment testing
Documentation for database troubleshooting was outdated
